# /loot: every target form with every source form (fish, mine, kill, loot), success and error cases.
# Flat world, creative; Bot = op at 0.5 -60 0.5, Bot0 = level 0. Tables are inline so the drops are fixed.

gamerule spawn_mobs false
gamerule random_tick_speed 0

# ---- setup ----
setblock 0 -60 3 minecraft:chest
setblock 0 -60 5 minecraft:stone
summon minecraft:pig 8 -60 6 {NoAI:1b,Tags:["p"],DeathLootTable:"minecraft:blocks/cobblestone"}
clear Bot
advancement grant @a only minecraft:story/mine_stone
